BiblicalUsage: Elchanan is an Israelite. The name appears in 2 Samuel and 1 Chronicles.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Elchanan matters because God knows His people by name — even the ones Scripture mentions only once.
RelatedEvents: David Becomes King; David's Mighty Men and the Philistine Giants
